files.note: Uploads above inline_max_mb go straight to storage (the host caps request bodies near 4.5MB), then are read and deleted.

ai.note: Hypothesis. Alert when cost per active user passes this. fair_use_cvs_per_day: tailored CVs one person can make in a day (Lagos time), any plan; set it lower if cost per active user goes over budget (D-192).

legitimacy.note: Days a job post's check, and a company's facts (website, start year, record), are reused for everyone before we look again (D-200).

matches.note: Jobs for you (D-205, D-208 to D-211): only jobs posted in the last max_age_days, in the country the person lives in or remote and open to people there (config/lists/remote_regions.json). Every job worth a full fit check gets one, best first, up to checks_per_search a search (founder round 40 lifted the daily cap; it was 8, from round 38), check_parallel at a time, none starting after check_seconds so the search finishes in time; the rest are checked on the next search. Jobs matching min_match % or more are listed (85 from founder round 37). With Tailor ahead on, CVs are written for listed jobs tailor_ahead_per_run at a time, within ai.fair_use_cvs_per_day (D-209). The list shows jobs added in the last new_days days first, marked New, then the most recently posted (D-210). Searches for the same role and place are shared for feed_cache_hours. The search runs by itself every day: the cron (vercel.json, every two hours) takes cron_users_per_run people whose last search is a day old, side by side; opening Jobs for You runs it for anyone it hasn't reached.

search.note: Days one web search's results are reused for anyone asking the same thing (D-200). Scam warning searches use cache_days_post.

notifications.note: Days before a pass ends that the reminder goes out.

shortlist.note: Questions in one mock interview, the opening and the closing question included (D-189).
